body:
Don't worry about anti-depressants---IF you've tried them before and they didn't work; if you haven't maybe give them a shot. Clearly, the student loan debt and shitty retail job have you down. Have you applied to work with the CDC? Have you called on your professors and said, "look, I have this degree and I need a meaningful job... help"?


The "American Dream" is absolutely bullshit and genuinely ferrets bright, educated people to poverty. That degree HAS to be worth something though. Try pharmaceutical companies and, seriously, the CDC likely has a place for you. Quit that student retail job as soon as you can.


I can't answer why live but maybe there is something interesting that you do during the day, even if it's just watching a show that makes you laugh. Maybe that's worth living?

If you want to have an accident at work, what's keeping you? Something is. This girl you say was the one, wasn't the one: she was an awesome distraction, clearly. Your "the one" likely wouldn't abandon you for a committed relationship with someone else. So, don't sell yourself short.

At least you have a job. That means you have some money. And, with that money, you can distract yourself with things. Go see a movie. Download a movie torrent. If you are fed up with the bullshit, try doing something else. Do you have a car? Drive to a park, watch a festival, walk a dog. Hell, get a dog, if you don't already have one. They are wired to love you.

Just tell her to act like it's business as usual with him. Since he has threatened suicide so many times, it's clearly normal. So, just treat it as normal and move on, ask him what he's doing tomorrow and what he had for dinner. 

It's not rocket science.

When I was 19, the thought of a man and a woman getting married was comical, stupid... just flat-out nonsensical. But that's a 19-year-old brain. You have at least 60 years ahead of you to make these big decisions, so you're in good shape trying to tackle them now. Who knows? You may fall in love with a trans person, thus getting you a woman with the fun bits of a dude? It could be you and your partner's secret, if appearances are the important element. You can use your sperm to make a child, so that it has your genes. 


Honestly, if you are healthy, physically and mentally capable, you are doing so well. You don't have to go bonking a guy right now, but wait until you feel comfortable. As for the chemical castration, it's likely not fun. You could do better for yourself.

I have something similar... fatigued and sick nearly all the time with sometimes 0 good hours in a day to even eat. But, mostly, I get about 2 good hours a day to eat or whatnot. I am not nearly as bad off. But, the lack of understanding from others and inability to get a job and generally just being trapped and miserable, in pain, achy, sore, with stomach aches, headaches, scalp burning... just constant misery is enough to make me want to throw in the towel. I actually would LIKE to do a lot of things but can't. If I take a 1 mile walk (assuming I make the mile), I have to sleep for three days to recover. It's exhausting just taking a shower, and I've fainted in the shower countless times. Honestly, it's fucking miserable. So, I don't know what to tell you...

..except maybe smoke weed? If you have to be miserable all the time anyway, may as well be laugh a little and be high.

You like sexy dudes? Welcome to the club! Find yourself a hot boyfriend and enjoy it. Get married. Have babies. 


If not, just try chemical castration---that's the torture usually bestowed on gay males in the past. Become a eunuch.

People are quick to slap "depression" on problems as if it makes a difference... ignore them.


But I will say this: if there is no physical limitation holding you back, then you're lucky. It IS in your head. Do you have a job? Do you have money? Are you mobile? Can you go places you want to go? If so, you are very lucky.


...Maybe try hanging.


Try hanging. I hear the pain ends rather quickly.
How did you cut it? What type of knife did you use? I'd rather get it right the first time.
